description: Canonical, checked-in catalog of known data regime breaks for the data sources this project uses. This is the SINGLE source of truth for dummy encoding — the frozen-skill contracts hash-reference this file so two recomputations encoding a break differently cannot diverge under the same skill_version. Populate via PR; never edit in place without bumping the schemaVersion.

breaks.label: COVID-19 additive outliers 2020-Q2
breaks.note: Treat with robust loss / X-13 AO detection. The pulse encodes the acute demand shock; some series also show a 2020-03 level shift.

breaks.label: M3 seasonally-adjusted model freeze
breaks.note: Census froze the M3 SA model from Jan 2026; SA series are not updated. All M3 refresh work uses NSA data throughout and sets this dummy so models aware of the regime change can adjust. Active now.

breaks.label: M3 Advance-report nondurable coverage expansion
breaks.note: Affects nondurable Advance vintages only. Included for completeness; not active in the total-manufacturing contracts.

encodingRecipes.pulse: 1 if date == break, else 0 (use a date-set for multi-month pulses)

references: Bai & Perron (2003), Computation and analysis of multiple structural change models. J. Applied Econometrics 18(1), 1-22.
Census Bureau X-13ARIMA-SEATS docs §7 (regression spec) for the user-regressor encoding of step/pulse dummies in SA.
